assets.prompt: Create one NEW standalone illustrated BLACK VINYL LP RECORD game asset for a 1980s Northeast China detective game. A perfectly circular complete 12-inch black vinyl record, viewed EXACTLY straight down in orthographic top view, centered on a square 1536x1536 canvas; the disc occupies 96 percent of the canvas width and height with an even 2 percent transparent margin. True black graphite vinyl, deep charcoal #171b18, gently warm-grey details. The main playing surface has richly resolved, extremely fine concentric physical record grooves in several unevenly spaced track bands, subtle smooth vinyl sheen, a few very fine restrained hairline scuffs and tiny dust specks. It must read unmistakably as a real BLACK VINYL RECORD, not a flat olive-green disk, a metal wheel, a rusty plate, a gear, a CD, a hologram or a radial digital gradient. Keep it clean and softly luminous, natural aged materials without heavy grime. A perfectly centered muted brick-red paper label, 34 percent of the disc diameter, has quiet fine paper fibers, slightly faded ink color #85463b and one very thin warm-ivory printed ring just inside its edge. The center label is completely BLANK except its thin perimeter ring. A tiny circular spindle hole lies at exact center. Crisp outer rim with a thin slightly polished edge, completely intact circular silhouette. High-quality hand-painted material rendering with restrained painterly grain, matching tactile ivory archive papers and olive cloth of a Chinese vintage mystery game's UI. Even soft diffuse overhead light; no dominant sweeping reflection wedges or harsh directional highlights baked into the record because it will rotate in the game with a separate stationary sheen layer. No cast shadow outside the circle. No lettering, words, Chinese characters, numbers, logo, watermark, tonearm, platter, player, controls, paper sleeve, desk, scenery or additional objects. Deliver a genuine RGBA PNG with transparent alpha outside the complete record, not a painted checkerboard or colored background. Save directly into the existing E:/东北迪斯科/public/assets/record-vinyl-painted-v1.png and create no output subfolder.
